indicator_name: Kazakhstan international investment position (IMF IIP), all components, end of quarter
description: Международная инвестиционная позиция Казахстана (МВФ), все компоненты, на конец квартала
methodology: Positions at the end of the quarter (dated 31 March … 31 December; NBK's IIP_NET dates the same position 1 April … 1 January). Item = A_P assets, L_P liabilities, NETAL_P net . indicator. NETAL_P.NIIP equals NBK IIP_NET on all 22 common quarters (2021 onward), dated one day earlier.
